item.description: postgres-0 is the primary, postgres-1 and postgres-2 stream from it, postgres-failover promotes a standby. Failover demo, then run this folder again: docker compose stop postgres-0; docker compose logs -f postgres-failover (FAILOVER: promoted postgres-1 after about 7 s); request 12 answers 200 again within about 15 s. docker compose start postgres-0 rejoins it as a standby. Commands: README, "Database replication and failover".

4. Caching of GETs and auth data (Grade 6)
item.description: Services cache their common GETs through cache-router (X-Cache: HIT|MISS) and evict on write. The gateway caches verified tokens (auth:token:{sha256}), User Management caches the login lookup (auth:user:{email}), and logout writes auth:revoked:{jti}, which the gateway checks on every request.
